title: Width Laws and Spectral Geometry
summary: We develop a common framework for random width laws, spectral populations, and geometric reconstruction. For a $d$-dimensional orthotope, we prove an exact parity law for the maximal $π^{-1}$-grade of every spherical width cumulant, including noncancellation and sign in all dimensions and orders. The first $d$ scalar width moments recover the unordered side vector, and $d-1$ moments are generically insufficient.
